slides.headline: Reply or remove? How to tell with a Trustpilot review
A real customer with a real problem: reply.
slides.body: A calm, specific reply often wins over the next reader.

slides.headline: Keep it short.
slides.body: Acknowledge it, say what you've done, offer a direct contact.

slides.headline: Never post order details.
slides.body: Their name, address or order number don't belong in a public reply.

slides.headline: A review that shouldn't be there: don't argue with it.
slides.body: Public accusations just put more eyes on it.

slides.headline: Don't do both at once.
slides.body: A heated reply can make a removal case harder.

slides.headline: Not sure which one you've got? Send it to us.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
